# 2 John

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

2 John emphasizes that Christian love must always be guided by truth and sound doctrine.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">2 John 1:6</div>

<div class="identifier">This is love, that we walk after His commandments</div>

### Why This Verse

Central message of the letter

### Chapter Insight

This chapter encourages believers to walk in truth and love while warning against false teachers. The key verse emphasizes that genuine Christian love is expressed through obedience to God's commands and commitment to His truth.
:::
